finding.title: Report dated 9 October references later 10 October evidence
finding.message: The report is dated 9 October 2026 but links to a 10 October audit and to fixes made after that audit (INPUT_ORDERING_FIX, MULTILINE_NATIVE_ADAPTER, VISUAL_TEXT_GEOMETRY_FIX). The header date is stale or the report was edited later without updating it. That makes the evidence chronology unreliable for a gate-tracking document.
finding.suggestion: Update the header date, or add an explicit 'Updated 10 October' note so the document does not cite a later audit from an earlier date.
finding.evidence: Current acceptance-check status is recorded in [the 10 October audit](FOUNDATION_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT.md).

finding.title: Acceptance gate lists the multiline native adapter as outstanding although it is declared implemented
finding.message: The report says the multiline Editor native composition/range adapter is now implemented, reviewed and tested, superseding its earlier missing-adapter status. The 'Still required before foundation acceptance' list still names that adapter as outstanding work. A reader cannot tell whether the adapter exists, and the acceptance-gate list overstates what remains.
finding.suggestion: Remove the adapter from the outstanding gate. Keep only the live-input and assistive validation that is still open, and link to MULTILINE_NATIVE_ADAPTER.md.
finding.evidence: 1. Long-document interactive layout and the multiline code editor's native composition/range adapter.

fix.before: 1. Long-document interactive layout and the multiline code editor's native composition/range adapter.
fix.after: 1. Long-document interactive layout. The multiline code editor's native composition/range adapter is now [implemented](MULTILINE_NATIVE_ADAPTER.md); only its live input/assistive validation remains open.

finding.title: Conflicting native document size limit between reports (1 MiB vs 4 MiB)
finding.message: This report says the native context ceiling is 1 MiB. The companion LARGE_DOCUMENT_NATIVE_INPUT.md, dated the same day, says native editable documents are capped at 4 MiB of UTF-8 with delta transport. Both documents are in the same change. A reader cannot tell which limit applies to the multiline editor adapter, or whether the later patch 0015 superseded this one.
finding.suggestion: Reconcile the two limits. If patch 0015 raised the ceiling, update or annotate this sentence (for example, 'superseded by LARGE_DOCUMENT_NATIVE_INPUT.md: 4 MiB with delta transport'). If the editor still has a 1 MiB limit, say so in the large-document report.
finding.evidence: The native context ceiling is 1 MiB, but the unchanged transport ceiling is 64 KiB per encoded message
